item.laowu.breeding_cat_food.tooltip.sum: Randomly inherits 3 complete loci from the parents; the other 3 are rolled from 0 to 100. Traits shared by both parents are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.super_breeding_cat_food.toolt: Randomly inherits 5 complete loci from the parents; the other one is rolled from 0 to 100. Traits shared by both parents are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.mutation_cat_food.tooltip.sum: Randomly inherits 2 complete loci, rolls the other 4, and gives the Breeding Box mutation chance +20%. Shared traits are guaranteed and one-parent traits each have a 50% chance; a successful mutation adds one new level-I trait absent from both parents.
item.laowu.attack_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better Combat Power locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.health_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better Health locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.speed_breeding_cat_food.toolt: Always inherits the better Speed locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.stamina_breeding_cat_food.too: Always inherits the better Stamina locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.intelligence_breeding_cat_foo: Always inherits the better Intelligence locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.luck_breeding_cat_food.toolti: Always inherits the better Luck locus plus 4 random loci; under suitable conditions its training limit can break through to 100. Shared traits are guaranteed; each one-parent trait has a 50% chance; inherited traits reset to level I.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.summa: Turns a tamed cat into a Mechanical Cat: a steady, balanced ranged fighter that protects its owner and fires lasers from up to 16 blocks away.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.behav: Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+6_; Armor Toughness _+3_.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Fishing Cat. While seated on a Seat beside a container, it fishes in water adjacent to the block below the Seat; larger waters fish faster, and higher Luck improves the loot.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.behaviou: Luck Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Flying Cat; sneak-use it to open its 27-slot portable inventory.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Flamethrower Cat that breathes a short cone of fire at nearby enemies and keeps adjacent Blaze Burners kindled without fuel while seated.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Stamina Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+40_; Armor _+10_; Armor Toughness _+4_.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Honey-Gathering Cat. While seated, it raises the honey level of the hive below every 10 seconds; in combat, it slowly fires heavy honey missiles that inflict Slowness II for 1.5 seconds.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Speed Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+24_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.summar: Turns a tamed cat into a Logistics Cat that becomes a package container between matching addresses while seated.
